questionText:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Name of the Committee)
List-II (Name of President)
(A) Provincial Constitution Committee (I) Vallabhbhai Patel
(B) Flag Committee
(II) J.B. Kripalani
(C) Supreme Court Committee
(III) M. N. Venkatachaliah

List-I (Name of the Committee)
List-II (Name of President)
(D) Constitution Review Committee
(IV) S. Varadachariar
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel chaired the Provincial Constitution Committee (A-(I)). J.B. Kripalani headed the Ad-hoc Flag Committee of the Constituent Assembly (B-(II)). S. Varadachariar presided over the Ad-hoc Committee on the Supreme Court (C-(IV)). Justice M.N. Venkatachaliah headed the National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution in 2000 (D-(III)). In the exam paper key options, pairing matches (A)-(I), (B)-(II), (C)-(III), (D)-(IV).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.

questionText:
Match the Constituent Assembly leader in List I with their historic contribution in List II:

List I:
(A) Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
(B) Jawaharlal Nehru
(C) Dr. Rajendra Prasad
(D) Sir B.N. Rau

List II:
(i) Moved the Objectives Resolution on 13 December 1946
(ii) Chairman of the Drafting Committee
(iii) Constitutional Advisor to the Assembly
(iv) Permanent President of the Constituent Assembly

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for The Making of the Constitution (Framing the Constitution) (Key Figures of the Constituent Assembly):
A-ii, B-i, C-iv, D-iii

Detailed Context:
1. Ambedkar = Drafting Committee (A-ii), Nehru = Objectives Resolution (B-i), Rajendra Prasad = President (C-iv), B.N. Rau = Constitutional Advisor (D-iii).
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
